en.title: Waste, Drainage or Road-Service Problem: Where Do You Complain?
en.directAnswer: There is no single office for every waste, drain or road problem in Bangladesh. First identify who controls the service: city corporation, municipality, union/local authority, road agency, water/drainage body or another office. Save photos, dates and the exact location, then use that authority’s complaint route. GRS may help for eligible government-service complaints.

atAGlance.whoFor: A citizen wants to complain about an everyday local public service.

en.lawMeaning:
The page must not send every local-service problem to the same national authority.

This page gives a general route. A person’s exact rights can change because of facts, documents, deadlines, legal status, court orders or later amendments.
steps: Follow up after the stated service time.
Use GRS if the authority/service falls within GRS and the grievance is eligible.
evidence: Relevant official notices, receipts, and correspondence
en.simpleExample: A drain overflows beside a school. The complaint should identify the exact road/location and responsible city/municipal authority, not simply say “government is responsible.”
commonMistakes: creating duplicate complaints with conflicting facts..
en.specialistTrigger: Serious injury; dangerous infrastructure; disputed private/public responsibility; repeated ignored complaint.
